title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC/24 > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF tracking via Audacity > FLAC/24 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear matrix capture of a mixed Norfolk show, highlighted by a smoking Scarlet Begonias>Fire>Eyes sequence and solid Peggy‑O/Bird Song performances.
ai_review.review: The matrix recording is praised as flawless, earning five stars for sound quality. Musically the concert swings between high drama – notably the intense Scarlet Begonias > Fire > Eyes of the World quadfecta – and weaker moments such as a mic‑less Alabama Getaway and an underwhelming CC Rider slide solo. Overall the show feels hit‑or‑miss, with strong second‑set highlights but a tentative first half.

ai_rating.rationale: Show receives mixed feedback (≈3 ★) while the recording is rated excellent (5 ★); weighted average yields a solid 3.6‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix source praised as crystal‑clear; reviewer gives it five stars for sound, noting no audible flaws.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain > Eyes of the World
poor_songs: CC Rider (Bobby's slide solo deemed wretched)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set starts unevenly but builds into strong moments; the second half delivers tighter, more inspired performances before winding down quickly.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Delivers hypnotic arpeggios during the Scarlet Begonias > Fire transition and recovers after a brief stumble on Eyes of the World; vocal mic missing early on Alabama Getaway.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby’s slide solo in CC Rider is criticized as wretched, though his vocal harmonies lock in well during the quadfecta sections.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland contributes vocal harmonies that mesh with Jerry and Bob during the quad; no specific keyboard performance noted.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart breaks a bass‑drum head early in set one, which may affect the flow of later songs.
